INSERT INTO leads (venue_name, email, website_url, phone, venue_type, status, county, source, notes)
SELECT
  $${{ $json.venue_name }}$$::text,
  $$$$::text,
  $${{ $json.website_url }}$$::text,
  $${{ $json.phone }}$$::text,
  $${{ $json.venue_type }}$$::text,
  $$new$$::text,
  $${{ $json.county }}$$::text,
  $$google_maps$$::text,
  $${{ $json.notes }}$$::text
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM leads WHERE website_url = $${{ $json.website_url }}$$ AND $${{ $json.website_url }}$$ <> $$$$
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM leads WHERE lower(venue_name) = lower($${{ $json.venue_name.substring(0,50) }}$$)
);
